**Description**
Test gap for the issue: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/3078

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Create DATAACL table and add a forward rule matching input interface (eg. Ethernet0)
2. Verify that traffic ingressing Ethernet0 is forwarded
3. Verify that traffic ingressing on any other interface is dropped

comments.author: neethajohn
comments.body:
The fix merged no longer uses the IN_PORTS qualifier: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/18659

Test gap should just ensure that DATAACL is successfully loaded on backend testbeds. Traffic tests will get covered as part of the entire nightly run
